name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus (formerly Victoria Terminus)
description: Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus is a working railway station in the heart of Mumbai, and one of the most extravagant ever built. Begun in 1878 and finished in 1887, it crowns its pointed arches and turrets with a great stone dome, mixing Victorian Gothic with Indian palace styles. Today it is still among India's busiest stations, with 18 platforms.
